# Chat Agent Relay

> Open-source middleware connecting any chat platform (Slack, Teams, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, WebChat, Lark/飞书, DingTalk/钉钉) to AI agent runtimes via the A2A protocol. Canonical event model, append-only audit ledger, enterprise governance, multi-agent routing, tenant isolation, encrypted credential storage, CLI-first configuration.

## Key Information

- [Quick Start](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/): 5-minute setup guide — install, pick a channel, pick an agent, set a route, start.
- [Architecture](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/concepts/): 17-package monorepo, 7-event pipeline chain, pluggable adapters on both sides.
- [Event Model](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/concepts/events.html): 15 canonical event types, causal chain via correlation_id/causation_id.
- [HTTP API](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/api/): REST endpoints for health, events, audit, and runtime config CRUD.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/ChatAgentRelay/ChatAgentRelay): TypeScript + Bun, 692 tests across 51 files.

## Channels (Chat Platform Adapters)

- [Channels Overview](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/channels/): 8 channel adapters — all normalize messages to the same canonical event shape.
- [Slack](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/channels/slack.html): Socket Mode, streaming, threads, reactions, rich messages, slash commands.
- [Microsoft Teams](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/channels/teams.html): Bot Connector, JWT verification, Adaptive Cards, threaded conversations.
- [Discord](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/channels/discord.html): Gateway, streaming, threads, embeds, slash commands, guild allowlist.
- [Telegram](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/channels/telegram.html): Bot API webhook, bot commands, progressive streaming, group/private chat.
- [WhatsApp Business](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/channels/whatsapp.html): Cloud API, HMAC-SHA256 verification, 24h session tracking.
- [WebChat](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/channels/webchat.html): HTTP + SSE streaming, slash commands, HITL resume, session management.
- [Lark / 飞书](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/channels/lark.html): Event subscription, auto token management, streaming. China + international.
- [DingTalk / 钉钉](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/channels/dingtalk.html): Robot webhook, session-based reply, staff identity. #1 China enterprise.

## Agents (Agent Runtime Adapters)

- [Agents Overview](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/agents/): AgentAdapter interface supporting streaming, HITL, session management, artifacts.
- [A2A Protocol](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/agents/a2a.html): Google's Agent-to-Agent standard. JSON-RPC 2.0 + SSE streaming. The sole agent protocol in CAR.

## Configuration

- [CLI & Config](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/configuration/): `car` CLI commands, SQLite-backed ConfigStore, dual-mode operation.
- [Multi-Agent Routing](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/configuration/routing.html): Route rules — channel match, pattern (regex), default fallback, priority-based.
- [Storage Backends](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/configuration/storage.html): ConfigStore and LedgerStore interfaces, SqliteConfigStore default, custom backends.

## Optional

- [Why CAR](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/why-car/): Comparison with DIY integration, positioning, technical differentiators.
- [Blog](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/blog/): Architecture deep dive, agent compatibility analysis, adapter capability matrix.
- [Pipeline](https://chatagentrelay.github.io/ChatAgentRelay/docs/concepts/pipeline.html): FirstExecutablePathPipeline, streaming, error handling, HITL flow.
